test_policy.notes: PFW is a test-optional institution; SAT/ACT are strongly encouraged (not required) for engineering applicants. Engineering (civil, mechanical, computer, electrical) needs one of: SAT Math 570, ACT Math 24+, PFW math placement 50+, AP Calculus AB 4+, AP Calculus BC 3+, or qualifying dual/college math credit (MA 15400+).

requirements.notes: International first-year admission: completed application, $30 application fee, cumulative GPA of at least 2.3 on a 4.0 scale, and proof of English proficiency. Official transcripts are sent directly by the school; PFW's Office of International Education prepares a credential evaluation for non-U.S. schools. The domestic fee waiver announced in March 2026 applies to domestic students only. Indiana law SB 256 adds a security review for some international applicants (see the PFW SB 256 page).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Citizens of the listed English-speaking countries (e.g. Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, Nigeria, Singapore, South Africa, Philippines) are exempt. Other ways to show proficiency: SAT EBRW 580 or ACT 20 (sent officially), O/AS/A Level first-language English grade C or better, IB English SL/HL 5+, ELS level 112, 'Academic English for Purdue Fort Wayne' with a C or better, two years of U.S. high school English with C or better (ESL does not count), or a U.S. university English course with C or better. Results are valid for two years.

english.notes: Exams before 2026-01-21 (0-120 scale). TOEFL Essentials 8 is also accepted.
Page lists 4.5 for tests taken after Jan. 21, 2026, without naming the 1-6 scale.
The undergraduate section prints 110; a graduate section on the same page prints 115.

aid.notes: Automatic PFW academic scholarships (no separate application; minimum 2.5 GPA, full-time, renewable). The out-of-state first-time beginner table, which the page says includes international students, pays per year: GPA 3.5+ $3,000, 3.0-3.49 $2,000, 2.5-2.99 $500. International students submit final transcripts by the end of the first term. The page cites students beginning fall 2022 and later; no international need-based aid is described.

majors.notes: International first-year engineering applicants need one of: SAT Math 570, ACT Math 24+, PFW math placement 50+, AP Calculus AB 4+/BC 3+, or qualifying dual/college math credit (MA 15400+), in addition to general requirements.

toefl.note: The PFW pages read do not print a TOEFL code (they list SAT 1336 and ACT 1217); confirm with the Office of International Education before sending scores.
